scoring_justification: The scored artifact is the final computed vibrational frequencies; no raw intermediate data is available to recompute the metric. A result-level comparison with tolerance is the correct method for a computed physical quantity.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference out-of-plane vibrational frequencies for hexagonal and pentamer-pair models.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.3d and text: hexagonal model main out-of-plane mode at 143 cm⁻¹, pentamer-pair model at 207 cm⁻¹.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported DFT results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own computational results; they serve as the expected reproduction target.

outputs.description: Main out-of-plane vibrational mode frequencies for the hexagonal-ring model and the pentamer-pair model. The checker compares each frequency to a hidden expected range.
